doc.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Cab's rhythm section, Mingus, marriage and the band's end
title: Marriage to Mona and the birth of their first child
summary: Taylor asks about family; Hinton says they married in Cincinnati after the Indianapolis escapade, and their first child was born in 1947.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: Let‟s talk about your private life for just a minute. You mentioned earlier that you met Mona when you were with Cab Calloway.
When did you have children? When did you have a kid first?
My first child was born in 1947.

Well we married. We married after that escapade I told you about with Cab Calloway and my mother coming down to Indianapolis, Indiana. We got married in Cincinnati. The same minister that George Wilson went to church with married us. We were deeply in love. It was amazingly. Mona was so… I can‟t tell you too much about her… I can‟t tell you enough.
I mean she‟s a pretty lady but other then that, what attracted her to you?
